## Message

```
[X18N1001] Plugin could not be loaded <detail>
├▶ fix: Install the plugin package, or check the path.
╰▶ see: https://x18n.antfu.dev/errors/x18n1001
```

The CLI prints the code and why the error happened, with details such as a file name or a field. The fix and a link to this page follow. With `--json`, the same parts are in `errors` of the [envelope](/references/json-contracts).

## What to do

x18n failed to load a plugin from `plugins` or `presets`.

1. If the specifier is a package name, install the package in the project.
2. If it is a path, make sure that it is relative to the config file and that the file exists.
3. Make sure that the module exports a plugin, a preset, or a function that returns one.

## Exit code

The CLI exits with code `2`.
